newsitem.title: USA: Jensen buys stake in Executive TeleCard.
newsitem.headline: Jensen buys stake in Executive TeleCard.

text.p: Executive TeleCard said on Tuesday that Ronald Jensen, the principal shareholder of UICI, had agreed to purchase 1,425,000 restricted shares of Executive TeleCard common stock for $7.5 million.

Executive TeleCard said Jensen will become its largest single shareholder as a result of the transaction. Proceeds from the purchase will be used for debt reduction and working capital, the company said.
Jensen, who serves as chairman of the board at UICI, a financial services company, will also be named a new member of the board of directors of Executive TeleCard.
Executive TeleCard is a telecommunications service company.
